name: Bird Feeder vs. Bird Bath
instruction: Could you create a 3D model comparing a bird feeder and a bird bath? The bird feeder has perches and seed holders, while the bird bath has a shallow basin for water.

Shape accuracy: The bird feeder has a rectangular or cylindrical shape with perches.
The bird bath has a shallow basin shape.

Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The proportion set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The perches on the bird feeder are positioned at accessible heights.
The seed holders are easily reachable for birds.
The basin of the bird bath is positioned at a height suitable for birds.

The bird feeder and bird bath should be positioned at a reasonable distance for easy access.
